headline: Management consistently targets long-term margin bands of 26% to 28% while near-term performance oscillates around 24% to 25%.

promises.promise: Inch closer to 26% to 28% margin band
promises.quote: while we will not shy away from making investments, we want to inch closer to our 26% to 28% band and we'll make all efforts to climb towards 26%.
promises.evidence: Operating margins stood at 25.3% in Q4 FY26, dropped to 24% in Q1 FY27, and remained at 24% in Q2 FY27.
promises.evidence_quote: Our operating margins stood at 24%, down 130 bps sequentially, primarily due to wage hikes.

promises.promise: Labor code impact minimal around 10 to 15 bps
promises.quote: We expect the ongoing impact to be minimal, around 10 to 15 basis points.
promises.evidence: Management stopped mentioning the labor code impact in subsequent calls.

promises.promise: Total order book projected around US$38-39 billion for the year
promises.quote: If this trend continues, we will be somewhere closer to about US$38- 39 billion for the year, which will be one of the highest.
promises.evidence: Reported TCV for FY26 surpassed $38 billion range based on strong quarterly wins.

promises.promise: International revenue better than FY25 in Q4
promises.quote: I think as far as international revenue in Q4 is concerned, we are optimistic, and we'll take every step that's required to see we reach the aspiration of having a revenue better than FY '25.
promises.evidence: No explicit international revenue comparison was highlighted in Q4 FY26 reported statements.

promises.promise: AI revenues to continue to grow with strong growth rate
promises.quote: We are seeing increased traction, good momentum across our client base and we expect AI revenues to continue to grow with a strong growth rate.
promises.evidence: Annualized AI revenues grew from US$1.8 billion in Q3 FY26 to US$3.1 billion by Q2 FY27.
promises.evidence_quote: Annualized AI revenue reached $3.1 billion and crossed 10% of our overall revenue.

promises.promise: Expect wage increment impact of 150 to 200 bps next quarter
promises.quote: On the wage increments, you should expect a similar impact on what we have seen in the past annual increment cycle, which had been in the range of 150 to 200 basis points.
promises.evidence: Operating margins dropped by 130 bps sequentially in Q1 FY27 primarily due to wage hikes.
promises.evidence_quote: Our operating margins stood at 24%, down 130 bps sequentially, primarily due to wage hikes.

promises.quote: We are also expecting a stronger 1H.
promises.evidence: H1 FY27 net profit reached ₹27,354 crore and sales reached ₹145,463 crore, showing robust growth.

promises.promise: Expect demand to improve in Q2
promises.quote: I expect the demand to improve sometime in Q2.
promises.evidence: Constant currency revenue grew only 0.5% sequentially in Q2 FY27, indicating subdued improvement.
promises.evidence_quote: In constant currency, revenue grew 0.5% sequentially and 2.8% year-on-year.

shifts.change: Shifted from aiming to inch closer to 26% in the near term to acknowledging 26%-28% is strictly a longer-term aspiration.
Management projected a demand turnaround in Q2 for manufacturing and life sciences, which translated to muted sequential growth.
